name: aionstruct-ai-builder
description: Semantic planning, portfolio uniqueness audits, deterministic previews, and offline compilation of original Minecraft Bedrock structures.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, audit, and compile Bedrock structures offline.
interface.longDescription: A constraint-first structure studio for AI Minecraft development. Author semantic Plan v1 components, audit portfolios for palette-swapped or rotated architectural clones, enforce purpose contracts, prove traversal and fixture support, render engineering previews, then compile deterministic .mcstructure bytes without Minecraft Editor.
defaultPrompt: Design an original Bedrock house as a semantic Plan and render its engineering board.
Audit this AIONSTRUCT blueprint for traversal and lighting defects.
Compare two designs, then compile the validated Blueprint to deterministic .mcstructure bytes.
Audit a structure portfolio for repeated topology and missing exploration-purpose contracts.
